context_notes: Deploy topology gotchas that cost the most time this session: (1) [skip ci] in the gated CNAME commit blocked Pages publish — every frontend fix looked broken until traced; now fixed. (2) Cloudflare Bot Fight Mode 403s plain curl — verify prod via browser User-Agent or `gh api repos/koa-inn/steins-and-vines-production/contents/<path>`. (3) Apps Script is deployed MANUALLY (paste + redeploy), not via git. (4) Staging frontend calls the PROD middleware (no staging middleware instance) — middleware changes reach prod via railway up or the gated deploy's Railway watchPatterns. (5) gated-deploy audit gate fails on newly-published CVEs because package-lock.json is gitignored (npm install resolves latest). (6) Zoho data changes propagate to the site within ~10 min (cache soft TTL) or instantly via the new Refresh-from-Zoho button / POST /api/admin/cache-clear.
